esim-plan-picker/bd-eoupb16a.note: Frutiger Aero gloss suits a travel data picker and the Arabic type is handled, but a rolled ink fingerprint pulls against the clean glossy digital look, and the signature white hero with one glossy button is a generic header that adds nothing to comparing GB and days.

esim-plan-picker/bd-jfvrrfxu.note: Gulf pearl trade scales suit a GCC plan comparison, but the Metro Ticket motion twist has nothing to do with the scales, and the signature shrinks the strong balance idea into a decorative pearl divider.

esim-plan-picker/bd-jma4rs7q.note: A plan picker has no usage or steps before purchase, so a hero percent bar measures nothing, and the one giant number should be the price or GB rather than a percent.

flight-checkout-gcc-ota/bd-l9w3evxe.note: Air traffic flight strips in a bay map cleanly onto the three checkout steps and suit a flight product with Arabic right to left covered, though the why line is thin and the clear total is not placed explicitly.

flight-checkout-gcc-ota/bd-wgbcaxgx.note: A transit style line with ringed stops showing the itinerary legs suits a GCC flight checkout and supports right to left Arabic, but a route line header is a familiar move that only touches the header.

flight-checkout-gcc-ota/bd-kou4letm.note: A desk globe suits a flight checkout and the Arabic type is handled, but the scale move is vague, the claim that the globe picks destinations does not fit a checkout, and curved latitude dividers are a small decorative touch rather than an idea.

coffee-shop-landing/bd-c60cnynz.note: A dallah hero fits a coffee landing page, but the brief never says Arabic coffee, and the spun sugar threads feel tacked onto a brass spout signature that ignores them.

coffee-shop-landing/bd-54703nsn.note: Iznik tile glaze and palette suit a global coffee landing page, but the woven rattan motion twist never shows up in layout, texture or signature, and the one raised red button is closer to a rule than an idea.

coffee-shop-landing/bd-rkky8d8i.note: A noren header split into cloth panels over a butcher block page with stained block anchors is a warm, buildable shop entrance idea that fits a coffee landing page, though the wood board look and block nav are fairly expected for wildness 4.

banking-onboarding/bd-4gma4tbi.note: A bento grid suits a dashboard more than a step by step onboarding, and the direction never says how the required clear progress shows, though the lacquer dark palette and single sheened hero tile hang together as a familiar, low surprise idea.

banking-onboarding/bd-67qb8gj8.note: Ledger cells that fill with ink ticks are a clear, buildable progress mechanic, and the palette, serif type and texture all come from the same account book, but the Bahi Khata is a regional Indian tradition on a global brief, which caps relevance, and the idea stays a fairly literal skin.

banking-onboarding/bd-uaa3cb3o.note: Swiss grid, Helvetica-like type and one red accent fit a calm global banking onboarding and hang together, but a bold confirmation line with a red check is a familiar move that gives clear progress no new idea.

fitness-empty-state/bd-o9m1pt9z.note: A surfboard outline is a fair sport-gear motif for a fitness empty state, but grain on the bottom bar has little to do with the board, and an outline over a text line and button is too tame for wildness 5.

fitness-empty-state/bd-mk0oap9u.note: Empty etched bar tracks could suit a fitness empty state with no data yet, but the rusted steel twist only shows up as an orange accent, and the signature is just a flat orange button, a rule rather than an idea.

fitness-empty-state/bd-14lp4b8c.note: Munich 1972 Olympic design suits a fitness app, and stopwatch dial texture links to sport timing, but the direction never says what the main dial and sub dials are on an empty state, leaves out the pictograms its own rationale relies on, and stops at a plain header bar as the signature.

ramadan-food-delivery/bd-pewg33ne.note: Karak tea suits a Saudi Ramadan page, but the amber fill tracks a value an offers page lacks and is pitched for order tracking, and the flat long shadow fits loosely with a ribbed glass.

ramadan-food-delivery/bd-s5ax8628.note: Parchment and a toasted crust button suit food delivery, but the tiffin carrier is a South Asian object on a Saudi brief, the recipe card is not on an offers page, there is no Ramadan cue, and the tiffin motion is never applied to the page.

ramadan-food-delivery/bd-ird4re8w.note: Gold stars on navy suit a Saudi Ramadan night, but an achievement card is a mechanic this offers page lacks, and the thermal receipt and foil sticker read as two separate ideas sharing a header.

saas-pricing/bd-47ajpvpk.note: Plan tiles sized like a treemap with the recommended plan largest in yellow is a fresh, buildable move native to analytics, though tile sizing must not blur the clear price the brief requires.

saas-pricing/bd-yhl3tjl7.note: Spec-table plans with a red-bordered pick fit a B2B pricing page and keep the price clear, but the 1980s postmodern mood pulls against the 1970s NASA manual, the fit note talks about dashboards rather than pricing, and a highlighted recommended plan is a familiar move that only the construction grid callouts lift.

saas-pricing/bd-l2rty3ep.note: A weather map hero with isobars and one red front suits a forecasting analytics product and leaves the price clear, but it decorates the header without touching the plans or price, so the idea stays mild.

dubai-real-estate/bd-d1e5ag8w.note: Mashrabiya fits a luxury Dubai listing and the GCC market, but the generic grain, linen and halftone textures have nothing to do with lattice screens, and a teak header bar with a bead line wastes the screen's real idea of filtered light and pattern.

dubai-real-estate/bd-ytciq82r.note: AlUla sandstone strata suits GCC luxury property, but Kilim rugs are an Anatolian and Persian tradition that caps relevance, and the colour band divider is pleasant but too modest and the kilim motion is never defined.

dubai-real-estate/bd-occ3s5z2.note: Square Kufic suits a Dubai listing and the section nav is a real mechanic, but the swatch punch hole sits loosely beside the Kufic grid, Space Grotesk undercuts the luxury tone, and turquoise-filling square tabs barely use the lettering.

kids-reading-home/bd-ezf849w3.note: Mirroring the layout for Arabic and English suits a global kids reading home, but the sewing button linen has nothing to do with the mirroring idea, and a hairline rule built on logical properties is a technical rule rather than a fresh idea for a wildness 5 brief.

kids-reading-home/bd-nvnh9evo.note: A flat-pack manual is a playful frame for a kids reading home, but a numbered step header assumes steps the home screen does not have, the single accent shape twist never shows up in the mechanic, and an underlined bar in Inter is far too tame for wildness 5.

kids-reading-home/bd-yrqt8oqw.note: Reading progress suits a kids home screen, but the near-black mono palette feels off for children, the felt-and-die header never connects to reading or the progress bar, and an empty gray track is too plain for wildness 5.

qatar-gov-services/bd-dpkhv81i.note: Metro lines suit ID renewal and fine payment steps for a Qatar dashboard, and Arabic right to left is covered, but the map mostly lives in an empty state and a progress card, so the transplant feels thin and the signature is modest.

qatar-gov-services/bd-m5md8vcw.note: Gulf modernism is a fitting regional civic language for a Qatar services dashboard, and the screen-block concrete and turquoise tile carry through. The tile-filling progress track gives multistep tasks like ID renewal a clear status, though Space Grotesk feels less 1970s than the rest.

qatar-gov-services/bd-c9yi4xw1.note: A calm signal box empty state suits a low-wildness services dashboard and keeps Arabic in view, but a slowly blinking amber lamp reads as a warning when nothing is due, which muddies the clear status it must keep.
